title: Amortized vector-credit pricing experiment & enterprise QSA readiness for rerank
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers building rerank pipelines with bulk embed calls report opaque per-call cost and inconsistent discounts when moving from ad-hoc batching to scheduled bulk imports. Goal: validate an "amortized vector-credit" model that treats embeddings/rerank work as ledgered credits that amortize per-vector cost across batched requests and provide a burst credit pool for short-term spikes. This ticket governs the PM experiment design, QSA (security questionnaire) language updates for contracts, and contract/ops changes required to support commitments tied to ledgered credits.
hypothesis: If we introduce an amortized vector-credit unit and offer tiered discounts for committed monthly credit buckets plus a small burst-credit ledger, then high-volume rerank customers will see predictable unit economics (+ lower apparent per-vector variance) and conversion to reserved commitments will increase by >= 12% in pilot accounts.
experiment_design: Offer two pilot commitment SKUs: 'Credit-Basic' (small monthly bucket, conservative discount) and 'Credit-Reserve' (larger bucket, deeper discount + burst ledger).
Map historical embedding usage for 8 pilot accounts to simulate credit consumption under amortized model vs existing per-vector billing; compute delta in per-vector price and monthly bill variance.

Run an A/B pricing experiment for 12 weeks: A = current per-vector + batch discount workflow, B = amortized-vector-credit with equivalent nominal unit-price but lower variance and explicit burst credits.
Expose billing preview tool in Console for pilot customers to see expected invoice under both models (frontend mock + backend simulator).
Require telemetry from runtime to emit per-request metadata: vectors_generated, batch_slot_id, credit_debits, fallback_variant, latency_ms.
Contract trial: update DRAFT MSA addendum with credit definition, rollover policy, and burst-charge terms for pilot enterprise customers.
success_metrics: Conversion to reserved credit SKU among pilot customers >= 12% (primary)
Reduction in month-over-month per-customer billing variance >= 20% for pilot accounts
No more than 2 customer escalations related to invoicing confusion during pilot
Telemetry shows >=95% of embedding calls correctly mapped to credit debits in simulation environment
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry event schema (ENG) created and validated in staging: embeddings.credit_debit events emitted with required fields
Billing preview UI in Console implements side-by-side compare for at least 3 primary workloads (rerank batch, streaming embed, bulk import)
Legal/Contracts sign-off on MSA addendum language for pilot customers and QSA language updated for enterprise questionnaire
Pilot cohort of at least 8 customers recruited and briefed; baseline usage imported for simulation
Backend billing simulation runs completed with clear per-customer delta report and recommended discount ladder
open_questions: What is the canonical definition of a 'vector unit' for mixed-dimension embeddings? (ENG input required)
How should credits handle failed calls/retries and partial successes? Do we return credits or mark as consumed?
What is acceptable burst ledger size relative to monthly bucket for legal and risk?
Do partner resellers need separate ledger tracking?
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Customers misinterpret credits as free tokens -> Mitigation: explicit examples in billing preview and pre-pilot onboarding call
Risk: Edge cases in rerank pipelines where embeddings are cached and double-counted -> Mitigation: add cache-awareness to telemetry and reconciliation job
Risk: QSA reviewers flag ledger persistence as sensitive PII storage -> Mitigation: redact identifiers and provide encryption-at-rest/KMS points in QSA response
implementation_notes: ENG-19840: add 'credit_debit' event to runtime telemetry with fields: account_id, credit_type, quantity, reason, batch_id, request_id
ENG-20456: billing simulator service that can replay 6 months of usage and output invoice delta under new SKU ladders
